text:
Maya Patel: seeing a spike in pod evictions across ap-southeast-1-gpu, started ~10:02 UTC, suspected after last night's image roll
Jamie Chen: ah yes we rolled cu12 images to canary pool at 02:00 local, was just about to check metrics :eyes:
Sam K.: logs show a lot of NCCL net timeouts and failed connect retries, nodes reporting repeated: "NCCL WARN NET/Socket : connect failed: errno 111"
Maya Patel: paste of one node dmesg:
```
[  234.123456] nvidia: module verification failed: signature and/or required key missing - tainting kernel
[  234.234567] kdlsym: unresolved symbol: jemalloc_arenas_init
[  234.345678] containerd: failed to start GPU container: /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libcudart.so: version `GLIBCXX_3.4.29' not found
```
Jamie Chen: jemalloc linkage error looks new, we patched base image to ship system jemalloc v5 for cu12 compatibility
Alex R.: we also changed the runtime loader flags in the canary image to prefer container /usr/lib over host, could be exposing mismatched libs
SRE Lead: immediate impact: ~12% reduction in usable GPU capacity due to evictions and autoscaler marking nodes unhealthy, rolling jobs into other regions causing cost spike
Sam K.: repro on staging: cu12 + host gcc13 mix yields missing GLIBCXX symbols in some older AMIs, fallback to CPU for those tasks, but for distributed NCCL jobs timeouts cause retries and job restarts
Maya Patel: ops-bot shows 8 nodes flapped in ap-southeast-1 in last 30m, provisioning backfill failing due to driver-module build timeouts
InfraProvisioner: build pipeline hit a kernel-headers mismatch on our stable AMI variants, DKMS compile fails intermittently: "unknown symbol: module_layout" when compiling nvidia.ko
Jamie Chen: plan: pin canary to cu11 image for ap-southeast-1 while we root cause, run a small subset with cu12+glibc updated AMI to validate
SRE Lead: can we do targeted rollback (no global) and leave canary in us-west to continue testing? Need to avoid cross-region cascading
Alex R.: yes; I'll add node affinity to the rollout job and set rollout-size=2, revert ap-southeast-1 pools to cu11 images
Sam K.: also recommend forcing jemalloc from our runtime package instead of container-supplied, that'll avoid the unresolved symbol until we align toolchain
Jamie Chen: creating a short runbook checklist now, will include commands to force-restart kubelet on affected nodes and to cordon/uncordon
DeployBot: deploy reverted: image:redwood-runtime:cu11-stable -> ap-southeast-1-gpu-pool @1735554600
Maya Patel: thanks, starting cordon/evacuate, will monitor NCCL timeouts and autoscaler
SRE Lead: next steps: 1) validate AMI toolchain (gcc/libstdc++) matrix for cu12, 2) test driver dkms build on canary AMIs, 3) update provisioning to surface jemalloc/linker mismatches earlier, 4) postmortem if rollout caused >10% capacity impact
Sam K.: I'll open a tracking ticket with logs and a minimal repro and tag eng-infra + eng-runtime
Jamie Chen: FYI cost team flagged temporary 18% compute cost increase from cross-region failover, will loop them in after we stabilize :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maya Patel: monitoring shows evictions stabilizing after revert, but keeping ap-southeast-1 at reduced allocation for next 2 hours as a safety window :thumbsup:
Alex R.: adding a probe job to validate NCCL allreduce across 4 nodes every 15m once we bring canary back with full AMI upgrade
SRE Lead: good. Post updates here. If anything changes escalate to paging list. :rotating_light:
